title: SAML setup wizard: robust metadata ingestion, validation, and admin audit hooks
creator: Amara Singh
description: Implement an improved SAML 2.0 setup wizard that performs deterministic metadata exchange and multi-level validation. The wizard must: parse IdP metadata feeds, validate certificates and signing algorithms, detect and handle certificate rotation, surface validation failures clearly to admins with remediation steps, emit audit events for every metadata change, and integrate attribute-to-role mapping compatible with RBAC v2. This ticket covers backend metadata parsing/validation, admin UI flows and messages, audit log events, and an initial e2e test plan.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can paste or upload IdP metadata XML or provide metadata URL and receive a detailed validation report
System validates entityID uniqueness and rejects conflicting metadata with a clear error and suggested resolution
Certificates in metadata are checked for expiration and signature algorithm; warnings issued for weak algorithms (e.g., SHA-1)
Clock drift tolerance is configurable; system tolerates up to configured skew and rejects tokens otherwise
Automatic metadata refresh from URL supports ETag/If-Modified-Since and logs refresh outcomes to audit stream
Any metadata add/update/delete action produces an audit entry with actor, timestamp, diff of metadata, and link to related settings in console
Attribute mappings for SAML assertions can be saved to RBAC v2 role mapping and previewed against a test assertion
Wizard UI shows step-by-step validation results, with links to remediation docs and ability to continue on non-fatal warnings
Unit and integration tests cover parsing of multiple valid IdP metadata variants, basic malformed XML, and expired cert cases
tasks: Design: final copy for wizard steps and error states (PM/Design review)
Backend: metadata ingestion service: URL fetcher with retry, ETag support, and XML parsing module
Backend: validation suite for entityID, cert expiration, alg whitelist/blacklist, and clock skew handling
Backend: schema for storing metadata versions and diffs for audit logs
Frontend: wizard flow, validation display, inline help links, and ability to save mapping to RBAC v2
Audit: wire up metadata-change events to audit-log pipeline, include metadata diffs and SSO actor
E2E tests: scripted SAML IdP simulator to exercise happy path and failure modes
Docs: Confluence doc and admin KB with troubleshooting steps and recommended IdP settings
design_notes: We will display validation results grouped as Fatal / Warning / Info. Fatal prevents save; Warning allows save with 'Save anyway' and logs action.

For certificate rotation, recommend showing both current and next certs when IdP exposes multiple KeyDescriptor entries. Automatic overlap handling: if next cert is valid, accept without requiring manual downtime.
Clock drift default tolerance set to 120s; configurable per-organization in advanced settings. We will log the configured skew with every validation result.
Attribute mapping UI will allow admins to select common attributes (email, eduPersonPrincipalName, uid) and map to RBAC v2 role IDs; show a preview using a test SAML response.
Use the existing audit-log schema but add fields: metadata_version, metadata_diff_url, validation_summary, and actor_ip. Keep messages human-readable for support triage.
risks: Parsing: IdP metadata XML variants are inconsistent across vendors (Azure AD, Okta, ADFS); we must harden parser to handle optional fields and namespaces
Security: accepting weak signing algorithms could open us to forgery — blacklist SHA-1 and weak RSA key sizes by default
UX: Overly aggressive fatal errors could block customers; provide clear remediation and 'force save' by org-admins while logging the action
Operational: frequent metadata refreshes could hit customer IdP endpoints; implement backoff and respect Cache-Control headers
test_plan: Unit tests for XML parsing and certificate extraction across at least 6 vendor metadata samples
Integration tests with mock IdP endpoints supporting ETag, 304 responses, and rotated certificates
E2E test that runs the wizard in headless Chrome, verifies validation UI messages, and saves mapping to RBAC v2
Load test for metadata refresh: simulate 10k orgs with weeklies refresh to ensure fetcher scales and respects rate limits
Security review checklist: threat model, algorithm whitelist, XSLT/XXE protections, and fuzzing against malformed XML
